workspace.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this landscape
workspace.forbiddenBody: This shared link points to a landscape or version your account can't open. Ask an administrator of that organization for access, or switch to one of your own landscapes.

contractChanged.message: This landscape moved to a server-hosted registry. Reload to keep editing it.

repointed.message: An administrator changed this landscape’s default version. You were kept on the version you were editing, because you had unsaved work here.
